title: Ireland ne 328 chase kar liye: Kevin O'Brien ka toofan 🌪️ #shorts
caption:
328 ka target… aur chase karne wali team Ireland! 🌪️

2 March 2011, Bengaluru: Ireland 111 par 5 the. Phir Kevin O'Brien ne sirf 50 gendon mein shatak jad diya — tab World Cup ka sabse tez — aur Ireland ne England ko 3 wicket se hara diya. Tab tak World Cup ka sabse bada chase.
